s03.counting.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Still ten! Loud or quiet, ten is ten.
s03.counting.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Count them again, but whisper this time.
s03.counting.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Count ten steps together across the room.
s03.counting.lesson.02.title: Count to Ten
s03.counting.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Count the fingers on one hand.
s03.counting.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Now both hands. Count to ten!
s03.counting.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Three left! Fingers can take away too.
s03.counting.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Hide two fingers. How many are left?
s03.counting.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Ten toes as well. What a body!
s03.counting.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Count your toes together, one by one.
s03.counting.lesson.03.title: How Many Fingers?
s03.counting.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Five, four, three, two, one — jump!
s03.counting.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Count down from five, then jump.
s03.counting.lesson.04.title: Number Order
s03.counting.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Two apples. Tap to add one more.
s03.counting.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: 'Now there are five!' One more, every time.
s03.counting.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Four apples. Tap to add one more.
s03.counting.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: One more makes the next number!
s03.counting.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Put out four stones, then add one more.
s03.counting.lesson.05.title: One More
s03.counting.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Touch each fish once as you count.
s03.counting.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Still five! Order does not change how many.
s03.counting.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Touch them in a different order. Still five?
s03.counting.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Five in, five gone. Delicious counting!
s03.counting.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Count five grapes, then eat them one by one.
s03.counting.lesson.06.title: Count and Touch
s03.counting.quiz.01.questions.0.prompt: Count the stars. Which numeral matches?
s03.counting.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFe: Tap each star as you count. Try again!
s03.counting.quiz.01.title: Count to 5
s03.counting.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFe: Touch each star as you count. Try again!
s03.counting.quiz.02.title: How Many Stars?
s03.counting.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFe: Three comes after two. Try again!
s03.counting.quiz.03.title: Which Number Is 3?
s03.counting.quiz.04.parentNote: Count both groups out loud before choosing.
s03.counting.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFe: That one has more. Try again!
s03.counting.quiz.04.title: Which Has More?
s03.counting.story.01.pages.0.narration: Five little ducks went out to play.
s03.counting.story.01.pages.1.narration: One stayed home, so four swam away.
s03.counting.story.01.pages.2.narration: At bedtime, all five came back. Goodnight, ducks!
s03.counting.story.01.parentNote: Hold up fingers as the ducks come and go.
s03.counting.story.01.title: Five Little Ducks
s03.counting.story.02.pages.0.narration: One smooth stone from the path.
s03.counting.story.02.pages.1.narration: Two red leaves from the tree.
s03.counting.story.02.pages.2.narration: Three! A feather too. My pocket is full.
s03.counting.story.02.parentNote: Hold up fingers as each thing appears.
s03.counting.story.02.title: Three Things in My Pocket
s03.emotions.lesson.01.parentNote: Name feelings out loud during the day to build emotional words.
s03.emotions.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: 'Sad. It is okay to feel sad.'
s03.emotions.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: 'Angry. Let us take a deep breath.'
s03.emotions.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tap the face that matches how you feel now.
s03.emotions.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Naming a feeling makes it smaller.
s03.emotions.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Tell your grown-up one word for how you feel.
s03.emotions.lesson.01.title: Happy, Sad, Angry
s03.emotions.lesson.02.parentNote: Remind your child you're there when things feel scary.
s03.emotions.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: A loud noise can feel scary. Tap the scared face.
s03.emotions.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: A hug helps us feel safe. Tap the hug.
s03.emotions.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Someone always comes. You are not alone.
s03.emotions.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Tap the person who helps when you feel scared.
s03.emotions.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Safe again. That is what hugs are for.
s03.emotions.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Have a real hug right now.
s03.emotions.lesson.02.title: Scared and Safe
s03.emotions.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: A party makes us excited! Tap the excited face.
s03.emotions.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Excited feels big and bouncy. Tap the jumping child.
s03.emotions.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Up and excited, then down and calm.
s03.emotions.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Jump three times, then sit down slowly.
s03.emotions.lesson.03.title: Feeling Excited
s03.emotions.lesson.04.parentNote: Offer a real hug and name the feeling together.
s03.emotions.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Sometimes we feel sad. Tap the sad face.
s03.emotions.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: A hug can help. Tap for a hug.
s03.emotions.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Telling someone makes sad feel lighter.
s03.emotions.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Talking helps too. Tap the two friends talking.
s03.emotions.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Finishing that sentence is a big skill.
s03.emotions.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Say out loud: 'I feel sad when...'
s03.emotions.lesson.04.title: When I'm Sad
s03.emotions.lesson.05.parentNote: Breathe along together when feelings get big.
s03.emotions.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Smell the flower. Breathe in slowly.
s03.emotions.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Blow the candle. Breathe out. Aaah, calm.
s03.emotions.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Slower each time. Your body is calming.
s03.emotions.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: One more time. Smell... and blow.
s03.emotions.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Use this when a real feeling gets big.
s03.emotions.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Do three real flower-and-candle breaths together.
s03.emotions.lesson.05.title: Calm Breathing
s03.emotions.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Faces say things before words do.
s03.emotions.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Make each face at each other in a mirror.
s03.emotions.lesson.06.title: Faces and Feelings
s03.emotions.quiz.01.parentNote: Name your own feelings out loud during the day to reinforce this.
s03.emotions.quiz.01.questions.0.correct: She feels sad. It's okay to feel sad.
s03.emotions.quiz.01.questions.0.prompt: Her ice cream fell. How does she feel?
s03.emotions.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFe: Look at her mouth. Try again!
s03.emotions.quiz.01.questions.1.prompt: It's her birthday! How does she feel?
s03.emotions.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFe: A big smile means... try again!
s03.emotions.quiz.01.title: How Does She Feel?
s03.emotions.quiz.02.questions.0.prompt: A gift pops out! How does he feel?
s03.emotions.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFe: Look at his wide eyes. Try again!
s03.emotions.quiz.02.title: How Does He Feel?
s03.emotions.quiz.03.questions.0.prompt: What can help when you feel sad?
s03.emotions.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFe: Asking for comfort helps. Try again!
s03.emotions.quiz.03.title: What Helps When Sad?
s03.emotions.quiz.04.parentNote: Do the breathing together before you answer.
s03.emotions.quiz.04.questions.0.correct: Yes. Breathe in, breathe out. Calmer.
s03.emotions.quiz.04.questions.0.prompt: Feelings feel too big. What helps?
s03.emotions.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFe: Shouting makes it bigger. Try again!
s03.emotions.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFe: Feelings get smaller when shared. Try again!
s03.emotions.quiz.04.title: What Helps a Big Feeling?
s03.emotions.story.01.pages.0.narration: Leo's tower fell. He feels frustrated.
s03.emotions.story.01.pages.1.narration: He takes a deep breath, in and out.
s03.emotions.story.01.pages.2.narration: He tries again and smiles. Feelings can pass!
s03.emotions.story.01.parentNote: Talk about a time your child felt frustrated and what helped.
s03.emotions.story.01.title: Leo Has Big Feelings
s03.emotions.story.02.pages.0.narration: In the morning I felt happy. I sang.
s03.emotions.story.02.pages.1.narration: Then I felt cross. My tower fell down.
s03.emotions.story.02.pages.2.narration: At night I felt calm. All of it was okay.
s03.emotions.story.02.parentNote: Ask which one they felt today.
s03.emotions.story.02.title: The Day I Felt Everything
s03.patterns.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: This balloon goes up. Tap what goes down.
s03.patterns.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: This cube is big. Tap the small one.
s03.patterns.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: This cup is full. Tap the empty one.
s03.patterns.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: A door, a box, a hand. Open! Shut!
s03.patterns.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Find a door that is open, and one that is shut.
s03.patterns.lesson.01.title: Opposites
s03.patterns.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: The soup is hot. Tap it.
s03.patterns.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: The ice is cold. Tap it.
s03.patterns.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Hot things need care. Cold things are safe.
s03.patterns.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Which would you hold with two hands? Tap it.
s03.patterns.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Your skin knows the difference straight away!
s03.patterns.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Touch something cold, then something warm.
s03.patterns.lesson.02.title: Hot and Cold
s03.patterns.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: The sun is out. It's day. Tap the sun.
s03.patterns.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: The moon is out. It's night. Tap the moon.
s03.patterns.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Night is for sleeping. Day is for playing.
s03.patterns.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: What do we do at night? Tap the sleeping child.
s03.patterns.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: You can tell just by looking!
s03.patterns.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Look out of the window. Is it day or night?
s03.patterns.lesson.03.title: Day and Night
s03.patterns.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Clap, stomp, clap, stomp. Tap to follow!
s03.patterns.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Try a new pattern: clap, clap, stomp.
s03.patterns.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: You are the one who decides it!
s03.patterns.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Make up a pattern with your own hands and feet.
s03.patterns.lesson.04.title: Make a Pattern
s03.patterns.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Red, blue, red, blue. Tap the next one.
s03.patterns.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: 'Red!' Patterns can be longer than two.
s03.patterns.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: A longer one: red, red, blue. Tap what comes next.
s03.patterns.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Spoon, fork, spoon, fork. A real pattern!
s03.patterns.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Line up spoons and forks in a pattern.
s03.patterns.lesson.05.title: Color Patterns
s03.patterns.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: The rabbit is fast. Tap it.
s03.patterns.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: The turtle is slow. Tap it.
s03.patterns.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Fast and slow, one after the other.
s03.patterns.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Tap the fast one, then the slow one.
s03.patterns.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Your legs can do both speeds!
s03.patterns.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Walk fast across the room, then very slowly.
s03.patterns.lesson.06.title: Fast and Slow
s03.patterns.quiz.01.questions.0.correct: You read the pattern. Red comes next. 🔴
s03.patterns.quiz.01.questions.0.prompt: Red, blue, red, blue, ... what comes next?
s03.patterns.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFe: Look at the pattern again. Try once more!
s03.patterns.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFe: It goes apple, banana, apple... try again!
s03.patterns.quiz.01.title: What Comes Next?
s03.patterns.quiz.02.questions.0.correct: You followed the pattern. Circle comes next.
s03.patterns.quiz.02.questions.0.prompt: Circle, square, circle, square... what's next?
s03.patterns.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFe: Look at the pattern. Try again!
s03.patterns.quiz.02.title: What Comes Next?
s03.patterns.quiz.03.questions.0.correct: Small is the opposite of big.
s03.patterns.quiz.03.questions.0.prompt: What is the opposite of big?
s03.patterns.quiz.03.title: Opposite of Big
s03.patterns.quiz.04.parentNote: Pour water between two real cups afterwards.
s03.patterns.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFe: That one is empty. Try again!
s03.patterns.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFe: That one is full. Try again!
s03.patterns.quiz.04.title: Full or Empty?
s03.patterns.story.01.pages.0.narration: Today is Opposite Day! The cat is up high.
s03.patterns.story.01.pages.1.narration: Now the cat is down low.
s03.patterns.story.01.pages.2.narration: Fast then slow, big then small. What fun!
s03.patterns.story.01.title: Opposite Day
s03.patterns.story.02.pages.0.narration: Up we go, slow and heavy.
s03.patterns.story.02.pages.1.narration: At the top it is windy and cold.
s03.patterns.story.02.pages.2.narration: Down we run, fast and warm and laughing.
s03.patterns.story.02.parentNote: Lift them up and lower them down as you read.
s03.patterns.story.02.title: Up the Hill, Down the Hill
s03.phono.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Ball starts with /b/. Tap the ball.
s03.phono.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Bear starts with /b/ too. Tap the bear.
s03.phono.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Banana starts with /b/ too. Tap the banana.
s03.phono.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Every name starts with a sound!
s03.phono.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Say your own name. What sound does it start with?
s03.phono.lesson.01.title: First Sounds: /b/
s03.phono.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Cat, hat, bat. They rhyme! Tap to hear.
s03.phono.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: They all end the same way.
s03.phono.lesson.02.steps.1.prompt: Words that end the same are…
s03.phono.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Cat, mat. They end the same!
s03.phono.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Which one rhymes with cat? Tap the mat.
s03.phono.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Silly rhymes are the best rhymes.
s03.phono.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Make up a silly rhyme for your own name.
s03.phono.lesson.02.title: Rhyming Fun
s03.phono.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Clap the parts: ba-na-na. Tap three times!
s03.phono.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Every name has parts you can clap.
s03.phono.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Now your own name. Clap its parts!
s03.phono.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Clap the parts of what you had for lunch.
s03.phono.lesson.03.title: Clap the Syllables
s03.phono.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Sun starts with /s/. Tap the sun.
s03.phono.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Sock starts with /s/. Tap the sock.
s03.phono.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Snake starts with /s/ as well. Tap the snake.
s03.phono.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Sssss! Your mouth makes the sound.
s03.phono.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Hiss like a snake, long and slow.
s03.phono.lesson.04.title: The /s/ Sound
s03.phono.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Mama starts with /m/. Tap the moon. It does too!
s03.phono.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Milk starts with /m/. Tap the milk.
s03.phono.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: You can feel it buzz on your lips!
s03.phono.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Hum mmmm with your lips closed.
s03.phono.lesson.05.title: Starts Like Mama
s03.phono.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: A snake says ssss. Tap to hiss!
s03.phono.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: A bee says zzzz. Tap to buzz!
s03.phono.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: A cow says moooo. Tap to moo!
s03.phono.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Copying sounds is how talking is learned.
s03.phono.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Take turns making a sound for the other to copy.
s03.phono.lesson.06.title: Make the Sound
s03.phono.quiz.01.questions.0.prompt: 'Cat'... which one rhymes? (Tap to hear each.)
s03.phono.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeedb: Say them slowly: caaat, haaat. Try again!
s03.phono.quiz.01.questions.1.correctFee: You heard it. Star and car rhyme.
s03.phono.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFeedb: Listen for the same ending. Try again!
s03.phono.quiz.01.title: Which Words Rhyme?
s03.phono.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeedb: Say them slowly: dog, frog. Try again!
s03.phono.quiz.02.title: Which Two Rhyme?
s03.phono.quiz.03.title: Starts with /b/
s03.phono.quiz.04.parentNote: Say both words slowly, stretching the first sound.
s03.phono.quiz.04.questions.0.prompt: Sun starts with /s/. Which one does too?
s03.phono.quiz.04.questions.1.prompt: Ball starts with /b/. Which one does too?
s03.phono.quiz.04.title: Same First Sound?
s03.phono.story.01.pages.0.narration: The train goes by with a cat in a hat!
s03.phono.story.01.pages.1.narration: Next a dog on a log, riding along!
s03.phono.story.01.pages.2.narration: Toot-toot! The rhyme train heads home.
s03.phono.story.01.title: The Rhyme Train
s03.phono.story.02.pages.0.narration: The bee says zzzz. Can you buzz?
s03.phono.story.02.pages.1.narration: The snake says ssss. Can you hiss?
s03.phono.story.02.pages.2.narration: The wind says shhh. Time to be still.
s03.phono.story.02.parentNote: Make every sound out loud — that is the whole lesson.
s03.phono.story.02.title: The Buzzing, Hissing Garden
s03.stories.story.01.pages.0.narration: Little Duck woke up. 'I want to swim!' (Beginning) Tap to turn the page.
s03.stories.story.01.pages.1.narration: She waddled past the barn and the big tree, looking for water. (Middle)
s03.stories.story.01.pages.2.narration: Splash! She found the pond and swam all day. (End) The end!
s03.stories.story.01.parentNote: Ask: 'What happened first? What happened last?' to build story sense.
s03.stories.story.01.title: Little Duck Finds the Pond
s03.tracing.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Trace the dotted path so the duckling reaches its mom.
s03.tracing.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: You did it! They are together.
s03.tracing.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Trace it again, a little faster this time.
s03.tracing.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: Real crayons, real lines. Same skill!
s03.tracing.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Draw a wiggly line on paper with a crayon.
s03.tracing.lesson.01.title: Trace the Path to Mom
s03.tracing.lesson.02.steps.0.feedback: The car drives along your line!
s03.tracing.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Trace the straight road from car to house.
s03.tracing.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Trace the road back the other way.
s03.tracing.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: The edge helps your hand stay straight.
s03.tracing.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Draw a straight line along the edge of a book.
s03.tracing.lesson.02.title: Trace a Line
s03.tracing.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Trace a smaller circle inside the big one.
s03.tracing.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: A perfect circle, made by your hand!
s03.tracing.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Draw around a real cup on paper.
s03.tracing.lesson.03.title: Trace a Circle
s03.tracing.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Trace up and down over the mountains.
s03.tracing.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Up, down, up, down. A mountain range!
s03.tracing.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Trace the zigzag once more, slowly.
s03.tracing.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Draw zigzags in the air with your whole arm.
s03.tracing.lesson.04.title: Up and Down
s03.tracing.lesson.05.parentNote: Point out the letter O in your child's name or books.
s03.tracing.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Two O's! Big O, little o.
s03.tracing.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Trace a smaller O beside the big one.
s03.tracing.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: It is hiding on nearly every page!
s03.tracing.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Look for the letter O in a book together.
s03.tracing.lesson.05.title: Trace the Letter O
s03.tracing.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Draw from dot 1 to dot 2 to dot 3.
s03.tracing.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Five dots, one shape. It grew!
s03.tracing.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: You decide what the shape becomes!
s03.tracing.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Make dots on paper and join them together.
s03.tracing.lesson.06.title: Connect the Dots
s03.tracing.quiz.01.questions.0.correctF: First she woke up. You remembered the order.
s03.tracing.quiz.01.questions.0.prompt: In Little Duck's story, what happened first?
s03.tracing.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFee: The beginning comes first. Try again!
s03.tracing.quiz.01.title: What Happened First?
s03.tracing.quiz.02.questions.0.correctF: That's the ending. She finds the pond.
s03.tracing.quiz.02.questions.0.prompt: How does Little Duck's story end?
s03.tracing.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFee: The end is the last part. Try again!
s03.tracing.quiz.02.title: How Does It End?
s03.tracing.quiz.03.questions.0.correctF: The story is about a little duck.
s03.tracing.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFee: Remember who we followed. Try again!
s03.tracing.quiz.03.title: Who Is in the Story?
s03.tracing.quiz.04.parentNote: Draw both kinds on paper straight afterwards.
s03.tracing.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFee: That one is straight. Try again!
s03.tracing.quiz.04.title: Which Line Is Straight?
s03.tracing.story.02.pages.0.narration: The line went straight, all the way to the gate.
s03.tracing.story.02.pages.1.narration: Then it curled round into a circle.
s03.tracing.story.02.pages.2.narration: Then it zigzagged home for tea.
s03.tracing.story.02.parentNote: Trace each shape on their back with your finger.
s03.tracing.story.02.title: The Line That Went for a Walk
s03.vocab.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tap the sleeping cat. What is it doing?
s03.vocab.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Action words are for doing, not just saying.
s03.vocab.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Run, jump and eat something — really do it!
s03.vocab.lesson.01.title: Action Words: Run, Jump, Eat
s03.vocab.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Drag the apple to the food box.
s03.vocab.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Drag the hat to the clothes box.
s03.vocab.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Drag the bus to the vehicles box.
s03.vocab.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: One more. Drag the banana where it belongs.
s03.vocab.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: They all belong to the food group!
s03.vocab.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Name three real foods in your kitchen.
s03.vocab.lesson.02.title: Categories: Food, Clothes, Vehicles
s03.vocab.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tap the window. What do we see through it?
s03.vocab.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Your home is full of words!
s03.vocab.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Point at a real chair, bed and door and name them.
s03.vocab.lesson.03.title: Around the House
s03.vocab.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tap the socks. Where do they go?
s03.vocab.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: You are wearing a whole list of words!
s03.vocab.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Name each thing you are wearing right now.
s03.vocab.lesson.04.title: Things We Wear
s03.vocab.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Tap the banana. Peel it and eat it!
s03.vocab.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Eating and talking, both at once!
s03.vocab.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Name the food on your plate at the next meal.
s03.vocab.lesson.05.title: Yummy Foods
s03.vocab.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: This soup is hot. Tap the steam.
s03.vocab.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: This puppy is wet. Tap the puppy.
s03.vocab.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: This stone is heavy. Tap it.
s03.vocab.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Lift them both. Your arms can tell!
s03.vocab.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Find something heavy and something light.
s03.vocab.lesson.06.title: Describing Words
s03.vocab.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeedb: We don't eat shoes. Try again!
s03.vocab.quiz.01.title: Which One Do We Eat?
s03.vocab.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeedb: An animal is alive. Try again!
s03.vocab.quiz.02.title: Find the Animal
s03.vocab.quiz.03.questions.0.prompt: What do we wear on our feet?
s03.vocab.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFeedb: A hat goes on your head. Try again!
s03.vocab.quiz.03.title: On Our Feet
s03.vocab.quiz.04.parentNote: Name the group out loud before choosing.
s03.vocab.quiz.04.questions.0.prompt: A shoe. Is it food or clothes?
s03.vocab.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeedb: We do not eat shoes. Try again!
s03.vocab.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFeedb: We do not wear apples. Try again!
s03.vocab.quiz.04.title: Where Does It Belong?
s03.vocab.story.01.pages.0.narration: Mia wakes up and puts on her shoes. Tap the shoes!
s03.vocab.story.01.pages.1.narration: She eats an apple for a snack. Yum!
s03.vocab.story.01.pages.2.narration: Then she plays with her ball outside. What a day!
s03.vocab.story.01.title: A Day with Mia
s03.vocab.story.02.pages.0.narration: Bread, warm from the oven. That is food.
s03.vocab.story.02.pages.1.narration: A hat, soft and round. That is clothes.
s03.vocab.story.02.pages.2.narration: And a small toy bus. Beep beep! That is a vehicle.
s03.vocab.story.02.title: What Is in the Basket?
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Mix red and blue. Tap to pour them together.
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tap the two colours that make green.
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Red and blue make purple. Good thinking!
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Which two would you mix to make plum colour? Tap your answer.
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Two colours, one new one. That is mixing!
s04.arts.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: You mixed three new colours today.
s04.arts.lesson.01.title: Color Mixing
s04.arts.lesson.02.parentNote: There is no right answer here — celebrate the effort and the colors.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Drag your finger to paint anything you like!
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Tap a new color and keep going.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Big and small together. Nice choice!
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Paint a big shape, then a tiny one beside it.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: One colour can say a lot!
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Now paint with only one colour.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Only you know what it is. That is art!
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Sticking with it is the hard part. You did.
s04.arts.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: You kept going and filled the whole page.
s04.arts.lesson.02.title: Finger Paint
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Draw two eyes and a nose. Tap to add them.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: A happy face. You made it!
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Two ears. The face is filling out!
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Add two ears, one on each side.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Now give it hair, any way you like.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: The same line, flipped, means the opposite!
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Draw a sad mouth instead. Turn it upside down.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Circles and lines. Now you can draw anyone.
s04.arts.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Faces are made of a few simple shapes.
s04.arts.lesson.03.title: Draw a Face
s04.arts.lesson.04.parentNote: Make a band with pots and spoons at home.
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Tap the bell, then the drum, then the bell.
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Play the drum four times, slowly.
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: The bell is softer. Good ear!
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Which one would you use for a quiet song? Tap your answer.
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: That is four ways to play one drum!
s04.arts.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: You played loud, soft, fast and slow.
s04.arts.lesson.04.title: Make Music
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Fast music. Dance fast! Tap to dance.
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.1.prompt: How do we move to slow music?
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.2.feedback: Still as a statue. Hold it...
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Now dance only with your hands.
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Slow and soft. You matched it well!
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Which music would you choose to fall asleep to? Tap your answer.
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Listening with your whole self. That is dancing.
s04.arts.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Your body followed every change in the music.
s04.arts.lesson.05.title: Dance and Move
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Let's pretend to be a lion! Tap to roar.
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Now pretend to be a tall giraffe!
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Now be something tiny. Tap the mouse.
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: A bird, a bee, a plane — you choose!
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Pretend to be something that flies. Tap your answer.
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: The giraffe! Pretending can solve problems.
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Which one would you be to reach a high shelf? Tap your answer.
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Your imagination did all of it.
s04.arts.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: You were three different creatures today.
s04.arts.lesson.06.title: Pretend Play
s04.arts.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeedba: Think of a sunset. Try again!
s04.arts.quiz.01.title: Color Mixing
s04.arts.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeedba: Which one goes boom? Try again!
s04.arts.quiz.02.title: Find the Instrument
s04.arts.quiz.03.questions.0.prompt: We drew a round shape. Which one is it?
s04.arts.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFeedba: Round with no corners. Try again!
s04.arts.quiz.03.title: Which Shape?
s04.arts.quiz.04.parentNote: Mix real paint or food colouring afterwards.
s04.arts.quiz.04.questions.0.prompt: Red and blue mixed together make...
s04.arts.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeedba: Green comes from blue and yellow. Try again!
s04.arts.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFeedba: Purple comes from red and blue. Try again!
s04.arts.quiz.04.title: What Do Red and Blue Make?
s04.arts.story.01.pages.0.narration: Leo finds a magic paintbrush. Tap to paint the sky blue!
s04.arts.story.01.pages.1.narration: He paints a yellow sun and green grass.
s04.arts.story.01.pages.2.narration: What a colorful world! Art is everywhere.
s04.arts.story.01.title: The Magic Paintbrush
s04.arts.story.02.pages.0.narration: Ada painted a yellow sun. A drop of blue fell on it.
s04.arts.story.02.pages.1.narration: The sun turned green. Ada stopped, and looked.
s04.arts.story.02.pages.2.narration: So she painted leaves around it. Now it was a tree.
s04.arts.story.02.parentNote: Say your own 'happy accident' story afterwards.
s04.arts.story.02.title: The Painting That Changed
s04.literacy.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tap the letter D. It says /d/.
s04.literacy.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: B! You matched the sound to the letter.
s04.literacy.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: B for ball. Letters and words go together!
s04.literacy.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Ball starts with /b/. Tap the letter it starts with.
s04.literacy.lesson.01.title: Uppercase Letters & Sounds
s04.literacy.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Big B and little b. Tap them both.
s04.literacy.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Sharp eyes. Little letters are everywhere in books!
s04.literacy.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Find the little a hiding among the big ones.
s04.literacy.lesson.02.title: Lowercase Letters
s04.literacy.lesson.03.parentNote: Sing the alphabet song together often.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Tap each letter as we sing A-B-C.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: '...X, Y, Z! Now I know my ABCs.'
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Every letter gets its own moment!
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Sing it again, slower this time.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: C! The song keeps them in order.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Tap the letter that comes after B.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Z! Twenty-six letters, and you know where they end.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Which letter is last of all? Tap your answer.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Those letters build every word you will ever read.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: You sang all the way to Z.
s04.literacy.lesson.03.title: The Alphabet Song
s04.literacy.lesson.04.parentNote: Show your child the first letter of their name.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Names start with a big letter. Tap the letter A.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Tap the letter that starts your name with a grown-up.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Names of places start with big letters too. Tap the K.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Everyone has a special first letter!
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tap the first letter of a grown-up's name.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Names get the big one. That is the rule!
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Which letters are big, and which are little? Tap your answer.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Your name is the first word you will write.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: You found your letter and somebody else's.
s04.literacy.lesson.04.title: My Name Starts With...
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Mmm. 'moon' starts with /m/. Tap the moon.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Sss. 'sun' starts with /s/. Tap the sun.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Fff. 'fish' starts with /f/. Tap the fish.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Moon and mouse. Same first sound!
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Two of these start with /m/. Tap them both.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Say it slowly and you will hear it.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: What sound does your own name start with? Tap your answer.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: That is the listening that reading is built on.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: You heard the very first sound in four words.
s04.literacy.lesson.05.title: Beginning Sounds
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Man, can, pan. They rhyme! Tap to hear.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Can you think of another? Fan!
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: They all end the same way!
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Cat, hat, bat. Tap to hear them rhyme.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Which one does NOT rhyme with man? Tap your answer.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: It does not have to be a real word!
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Make up a silly rhyme for your own name. Tap your answer.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: You did it four times. Your ears are getting sharp!
s04.literacy.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Rhyming is hearing the end of a word.
s04.literacy.lesson.06.title: Rhyme Time
s04.literacy.quiz.01.questions.0.correct: B for ball. You heard the first sound.
s04.literacy.quiz.01.questions.1.retryFe: /s/-un. Try again, you can do it!
s04.literacy.quiz.01.title: Find the First Letter
s04.literacy.quiz.02.title: Letter and Sound
s04.literacy.quiz.03.title: Starts with S
s04.literacy.quiz.04.parentNote: Stretch the sound out before they choose.
s04.literacy.quiz.04.title: Which Letter Says That?
s04.literacy.story.01.pages.0.narration: Three little pigs set off to build their homes. (Beginning)
s04.literacy.story.01.pages.1.narration: One built with straw, one with sticks, one with strong bricks. (Middle)
s04.literacy.story.01.pages.2.narration: The brick house kept everyone safe and warm. (End) The end!
s04.literacy.story.01.title: The Three Little Pigs
s04.literacy.story.02.pages.0.narration: Little b went missing from the alphabet.
s04.literacy.story.02.pages.1.narration: They found it in ball, and in bird, and in book.
s04.literacy.story.02.pages.2.narration: It had been busy all along, holding words together.
s04.literacy.story.02.parentNote: Hunt for the same letter on a real page after.
s04.literacy.story.02.title: The Letter That Was Lost
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Tap each balloon to count them.
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: Ten, nine, eight... all the way to one!
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: One balloon floats away. How many now?
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Five and five is still ten. Same total!
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Count the balloons in two groups: five and five.
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Ten is ten however you get there.
s04.math.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: You counted up, down, and in groups.
s04.math.lesson.01.title: Count to 10
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: Count 3 apples, then drag them to the number 3.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: 4! The numeral stands for the count.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Here are 4 apples. Tap the number that says how many.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Every number has its place in the line.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Put the numbers 1 to 5 in order.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: That is the idea the rest of maths sits on.
s04.math.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Counting and numerals now mean the same thing to you.
s04.math.lesson.02.title: Count and Match
s04.math.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Hold up 1 finger and 1 more. How many?
s04.math.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Hold up 2 fingers and 2 more. How many?
s04.math.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: You have 4 and I give you 1. How many?
s04.math.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Your hands are the first calculator you will own.
s04.math.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Adding is just putting groups together.
s04.math.lesson.03.title: Add with Fingers
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Tap the circle, then the square.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Now the triangle and the rectangle.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Three! That is what makes it a triangle.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: How many sides does the triangle have? Tap them.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: The circle. Round all the way!
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Which shape has no corners at all? Tap your answer.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: Shapes are hiding in every object!
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Find a shape in this room, then tap the one that matches.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Corners and sides are how you tell them apart.
s04.math.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Four shapes, and you can name them all.
s04.math.lesson.04.title: Four Shapes
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Line up the bears: small, medium, big.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Now line them up the other way: big to small.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: The medium one — not biggest, not smallest.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Which bear is in the middle? Tap your answer.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: You found its place by comparing. Clever!
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Add a fourth bear. Where does it go?
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: You did it forwards and backwards.
s04.math.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Ordering means comparing, one pair at a time.
s04.math.lesson.05.title: Sort by Size
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Circle, square, circle, square... tap the next.
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Now red, blue, green, red, blue... what's next?
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Circle, square. The pattern keeps going!
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Circle, square, circle, square. Tap the next two.
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: Big! Some patterns take three to repeat.
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Here is a harder one: big, big, small. What is next? Tap your answer.
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: You are the one who decides the rule!
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Make your own pattern with claps and stomps. Tap your answer.
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Spotting the rule is the whole trick.
s04.math.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: A pattern is a rule that repeats.
s04.math.lesson.06.title: Make a Pattern
s04.math.quiz.01.questions.0.correctFeed: You compared them. That one is longer.
s04.math.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeedba: Look end to end. Try again!
s04.math.quiz.01.title: Longer or Shorter?
s04.math.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeedba: Touch each duck as you count. Try again!
s04.math.quiz.02.title: How Many?
s04.math.quiz.03.title: Which Is More?
s04.math.quiz.04.parentNote: Say the pattern out loud together first.
s04.math.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeedba: The triangle is not in this pattern. Try again!
s04.math.quiz.04.questions.1.correctFeed: Small! This one repeats in threes.
s04.math.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFeedba: Count the rule again: big, big, small. Try again!
s04.math.quiz.04.title: What Comes Next?
s04.math.story.01.pages.0.narration: In Shape Town, the houses are squares.
s04.math.story.01.pages.1.narration: The sun is a circle and the roofs are triangles.
s04.math.story.01.pages.2.narration: Count the shapes you see. What a shapely town!
s04.math.story.01.title: Shape Town
s04.math.story.02.pages.0.narration: Juma found five stones and lined them up.
s04.math.story.02.pages.1.narration: Smallest first, then bigger, then biggest of all.
s04.math.story.02.pages.2.narration: One rolled away. Four left — still a line.
s04.math.story.02.parentNote: Line up five real objects and count them.
s04.math.story.02.title: Five Stones in a Row
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Tap the eyes. What do we do?
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tap the tongue. What do we do with it?
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: 'We touch with our hands. Five senses!'
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Tap the hands. That is the fifth sense.
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Touch! Each sense has its own job.
s04.science.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Which sense tells you the bread is warm? Tap your answer.
s04.science.lesson.01.title: The Five Senses
s04.science.lesson.02.parentNote: Look out the window and name today's weather.
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Tap the windy day. See the trees bend.
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Rainy! Weather changes what we wear.
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Which weather needs an umbrella? Tap your answer.
s04.science.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: You read the real sky. That is science!
s04.science.lesson.02.title: What's the Weather?
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Plant the seed and give it water. Tap to water.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: A little sprout grows. Plants need water and sun!
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Leaves unfold. It is getting bigger!
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Wait a few days. Tap to see it grow taller.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: It droops. Plants need water every time.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: What if we forget the water? Tap to see.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Water and sun. You worked it out!
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Which two things does every plant need? Tap your answer.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Slowly, and with care. That is how growing works.
s04.science.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: You grew a plant from a seed.
s04.science.lesson.03.title: How Plants Grow
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: In the day we see the sun. Tap it.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: At night we see the moon and stars. Tap them.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Tap the clouds that drift across the day sky.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: The moon. The sky changes with the hour!
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Which one would you see at bedtime? Tap your answer.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: You looked and you knew. Good observing!
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Is it day or night right now? Tap it.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: It turns from one to the other every single day.
s04.science.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: The same sky, two different faces.
s04.science.lesson.04.title: Day and Night Sky
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: A baby dog is a puppy. Drag the puppy to the dog.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: A baby cat is a kitten. Drag it to the cat.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: A baby sheep is a lamb. Drag it to the sheep.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: The calf! Every baby has a grown-up shape.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Which baby will grow up to be the cow? Tap your answer.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Food, warmth and care. Just like you!
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: What do all the babies need from their grown-ups? Tap your answer.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Every animal starts small, the way you did.
s04.science.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Three babies matched to three grown-ups.
s04.science.lesson.05.title: Animal Babies
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Drop the leaf in water. Does it float?
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.1.feedback: It sinks to the bottom. Splash!
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Drop the stone. Does it sink?
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: It floats! Light things sit on top.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Drop the cork in the water. Tap it and watch.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: It sinks. Heavy for its size!
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Now tap the coin to drop it in.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Guessing first is what scientists do!
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Guess first, then tap the sponge to drop it.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Guess, test, find out. That is how science works.
s04.science.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: You tested four things and guessed the last one.
s04.science.lesson.06.title: Float or Sink
s04.science.quiz.01.questions.0.correctF: The cold Arctic is home for a polar bear.
s04.science.quiz.01.questions.0.prompt: Where does the polar bear live?
s04.science.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFee: A polar bear likes the cold. Try again!
s04.science.quiz.01.title: Where Do I Live?
s04.science.quiz.02.questions.0.correctF: Water and sunshine. That's what a plant needs.
s04.science.quiz.02.questions.0.prompt: What does a plant need to grow?
s04.science.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFee: Plants drink and soak up sun. Try again!
s04.science.quiz.02.title: What Do Plants Need?
s04.science.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFee: Who likes to swim? Try again!
s04.science.quiz.03.title: Lives in Water
s04.science.quiz.04.parentNote: Water a real plant together after this.
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.0.correctF: Water! Sun and water, every time.
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFee: Plants do not play with toys. Try again!
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.1.correctF: It droops. Water is not optional!
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.1.prompt: What happens with no water at all?
s04.science.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFee: Without water it cannot grow at all. Try again!
s04.science.quiz.04.title: What Do Plants Need?
s04.science.story.01.pages.0.narration: Drip-drop! It starts to rain. Tap to open the umbrella.
s04.science.story.01.pages.2.narration: The sun comes out and makes a rainbow. So pretty!
s04.science.story.01.title: A Rainy Day
s04.science.story.02.pages.0.narration: The seed sat in the dark soil. Nothing happened.
s04.science.story.02.pages.1.narration: Rain came. Then the sun. Still nothing, for days.
s04.science.story.02.pages.2.narration: Then one morning, a small green shoot.
s04.science.story.02.parentNote: Plant a real seed and check it each day.
s04.science.story.02.title: The Seed That Waited
s04.semotional.lesson.01.parentNote: A great tool for big feelings — breathe along together.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.0.feedbac: Balloon fills slowly with a soft tone.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.0.narrati: Breathe in as the balloon grows. Hold...
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.1.feedbac: Calm chime. 'You did it. Feel calmer?'
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.1.narrati: Breathe out as the balloon shrinks. Aaah.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.2.feedbac: Slower than the first one. Well done.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.2.narrati: One more slow breath in... and out.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.3.feedbac: Three. You did that without help!
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.3.narrati: Now three breaths on your own. Count them.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.4.feedbac: Yes — when a feeling gets too big.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.4.narrati: When would this help? Tap the cross face.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.5.feedbac: Nobody can take your breathing away.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.steps.5.narrati: You have a tool now, and it goes everywhere with you.
s04.semotional.lesson.01.title: Calm-Down Breathing
s04.semotional.lesson.02.parentNote: Praise sharing when you see it.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.0.feedbac: Now both can play. Sharing is kind!
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.0.narrati: Two friends, one ball. Tap to share it.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.1.feedbac: Your turn, my turn. Fun for everyone!
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.2.narrati: Now there are three friends and two balls. Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.3.feedbac: Invite them in. That is the kind answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.3.narrati: Someone is left out. What could you do? Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.4.feedbac: Good! It feels the same for them.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.4.narrati: How does it feel when someone shares with you? Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.5.feedbac: That effort is the thing worth being proud of.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.steps.5.narrati: Sharing is hard, and you worked it out anyway.
s04.semotional.lesson.02.title: Sharing with Friends
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.0.narrati: This feeling is frustrated. Tap the face.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.1.narrati: This one is proud. Tap the face.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.2.narrati: This one is worried. Tap the face.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.3.feedbac: Proud! You have felt that one.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.3.narrati: Which face matches finishing something hard? Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.4.narrati: Which one are you closest to right now? Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.5.feedbac: A feeling you can name is a feeling you can handle.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.steps.5.narrati: Four feelings, and now you have words for them.
s04.semotional.lesson.03.title: Naming Big Feelings
s04.semotional.lesson.04.parentNote: Help your child find words to repair after conflict.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.0.narrati: Oops. We bumped a friend. Tap to say 'I'm sorry.'
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.1.narrati: Now offer a hug or help.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.2.feedbac: Slow and true. That is a real sorry.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.2.narrati: Sorry works best when we mean it. Tap to say it slowly.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.3.feedbac: Give them time. Sorry is a start, not a fix.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.3.narrati: What if they are still sad after sorry? Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.4.feedbac: Being on the other side helps you understand.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.4.narrati: Has someone said sorry to you? Tap how it felt.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.5.feedbac: You practised the hard part today.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.steps.5.narrati: Saying sorry takes courage, not just words.
s04.semotional.lesson.04.title: Saying Sorry
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.0.narrati: A friend dropped their toys. Tap to help pick them up.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.1.narrati: Helping makes us both feel good.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.1.prompt: Who feels good when you help?
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.2.feedbac: You reached it for them. Kind!
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.2.narrati: Someone cannot reach a cup. Tap to help.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.3.feedbac: 'Would you like help?' Asking is part of helping.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.3.narrati: Some help is not wanted. What should you ask first? Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.steps.4.narrati: Who could you help at home today? Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.05.title: Helping Hands
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.0.feedbac: Keep going. You can do it!
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.0.narrati: The puzzle is tricky. Take a breath and try again. Tap to try.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.1.narrati: You did it! Trying again works.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.1.prompt: What works when it is hard?
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.2.feedbac: Two tries. That is not giving up!
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.2.narrati: Still tricky. Take another breath and try once more. Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.3.feedbac: Asking for help. That is brave, not weak.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.3.narrati: What helps when something is too hard alone? Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.4.feedbac: You can do it now. That is what practice does.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.4.narrati: Think of something you could not do last year. Tap your answer.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.5.feedbac: You proved that to yourself today.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.steps.5.narrati: Hard is not the same as impossible.
s04.semotional.lesson.06.title: I Can Do It
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.0.corre: Taking turns is fair and kind.
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.0.promp: Two friends want the same toy. What is the kind thing to do?
s04.semotional.quiz.01.questions.0.retry: How can both friends be happy? Try again!
s04.semotional.quiz.01.title: Taking Turns
s04.semotional.quiz.02.questions.0.corre: A deep breath helps you calm down.
s04.semotional.quiz.02.questions.0.promp: What can help when you feel angry?
s04.semotional.quiz.02.questions.0.retry: A calm body helps. Try again!
s04.semotional.quiz.02.title: When You're Angry
s04.semotional.quiz.03.questions.0.promp: Your friend feels sad. What can you do?
s04.semotional.quiz.03.questions.0.retry: A kind friend helps. Try again!
s04.semotional.quiz.03.title: A Friend Is Sad
s04.semotional.quiz.04.questions.0.corre: Yes. Effort is the part that counts.
s04.semotional.quiz.04.questions.0.promp: The puzzle will not fit. What helps most?
s04.semotional.quiz.04.questions.0.retry: Throwing it does not solve it. Try again!
s04.semotional.quiz.04.questions.1.promp: And if it is still too hard alone?
s04.semotional.quiz.04.questions.1.retry: Giving up ends the try. Try again!
s04.semotional.quiz.04.title: What Helps When It's Hard?
s04.semotional.story.01.pages.0.narratio: Sara and Kofi both want the swing.
s04.semotional.story.01.pages.1.narratio: They decide to take turns. 'You first!'
s04.semotional.story.01.pages.2.narratio: Now they push each other and laugh. Good friends share!
s04.semotional.story.01.parentNote: Talk about what makes someone a good friend.
s04.semotional.story.01.title: Best Friends
s04.semotional.story.02.pages.0.narratio: Neema built a tower. On the ninth block, it fell.
s04.semotional.story.02.pages.1.narratio: Her face went hot. She wanted to push it all away.
s04.semotional.story.02.pages.2.narratio: Instead she breathed out, slowly. And started again.
s04.semotional.story.02.parentNote: Name a time you had to start over.
s04.semotional.story.02.title: The Tower That Fell
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Tap the farmer who grows our food.
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: The doctor or nurse. You knew who helps!
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Who would you go to with a hurt knee? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: They are real people in your own town.
s04.social.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Which helper have you met in real life? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.01.title: Community Helpers
s04.social.lesson.02.parentNote: Talk about who is in your family.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Tap the baby and the grandparent.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: 'Some families have many children, some have one.'
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Tap the brother and the sister.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Your family is exactly the right shape.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: Who lives in your home? Tap them all.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Eating, playing, resting — all of it counts.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: What does your family do together? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: What they share is looking after each other.
s04.social.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Families come in every shape there is.
s04.social.lesson.02.title: My Family
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: 'Store and park. Places in our town.'
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Tap the store and the park.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Tap the hospital and the market.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: The library! Every place has its job.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Where would you go to borrow a book? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Your town is made of places like these.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Which of these have you been to? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: That is a map, held in your head.
s04.social.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: You named four places and what each is for.
s04.social.lesson.03.title: Places in My Town
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: 'On water, and up in the sky!'
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Tap the boat and the plane.
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: The boat. Each way of travelling suits a place.
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Which one would take you across the sea? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Even walking is a way to travel!
s04.social.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: How did you travel today? Tap it.
s04.social.lesson.04.title: Ways to Travel
s04.social.lesson.05.parentNote: Model please and thank you in daily life.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: To ask nicely, we say please. Tap to say please.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: When someone helps, we say thank you.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Someone gives you a gift. Tap what you say.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: You bump into someone by accident. What now? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Saying it out loud is what makes it count.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Who could you say thank you to today? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: Four small words that make people feel good.
s04.social.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Please, thank you, sorry, excuse me.
s04.social.lesson.05.title: Being Kind
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Litter goes in the bin, not on the ground. Tap to clean up.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: We can recycle, too. Tap the recycling bin.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Turn off the tap while you brush. Tap to save water.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: The recycling. It gets used again!
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Where does this bottle belong? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: Pick one thing and really do it.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: What could you do for the Earth this week? Tap your answer.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: The Earth notices small hands too.
s04.social.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Bins, recycling, water. Three ways to help.
s04.social.lesson.06.title: Care for Our Earth
s04.social.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeed: Who uses a hose? Try again!
s04.social.quiz.01.title: Who Helps?
s04.social.quiz.02.questions.0.prompt: Who helps us learn at school?
s04.social.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeed: Who is at the front of the class? Try again!
s04.social.quiz.02.title: Who Teaches?
s04.social.quiz.03.questions.0.correctFe: 'Thank you' is a kind thing to say.
s04.social.quiz.03.questions.0.prompt: Someone helps you. What do you say?
s04.social.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFeed: Saying thanks is polite. Try again!
s04.social.quiz.03.title: Kind Words
s04.social.quiz.04.parentNote: Point out these helpers when you are out.
s04.social.quiz.04.questions.0.correctFe: A doctor. You knew who to ask!
s04.social.quiz.04.questions.0.prompt: Your knee is hurt. Who helps?
s04.social.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeed: A farmer grows food. Try again!
s04.social.quiz.04.questions.1.correctFe: A farmer. Thank them at dinner!
s04.social.quiz.04.questions.1.prompt: Who grows the food we eat?
s04.social.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFeed: Doctors help us feel better. Try again!
s04.social.quiz.04.title: Who Would You Ask?
s04.social.story.01.pages.0.narration: Amara and Dad take the bus to the market. Beep!
s04.social.story.01.pages.1.narration: The seller smiles. 'Two apples, please!' says Amara.
s04.social.story.01.pages.2.narration: 'Thank you!' They walk home together. What a nice day.
s04.social.story.01.title: A Trip to the Market
s04.social.story.02.pages.0.narration: The baker is awake before anyone else.
s04.social.story.02.pages.1.narration: The nurse works while the town sleeps.
s04.social.story.02.pages.2.narration: And you help too, when you carry your own bag.
s04.social.story.02.parentNote: Ask who helps in your own street.
s04.social.story.02.title: Everyone Has a Job
s05.coding.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Which block moves the duck one step ahead?
s05.coding.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Which block changes the direction it faces?
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Drag a forward arrow so the duck moves one step.
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: Duck reaches the pond! You gave it directions.
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Add turn left, then forward, and press go.
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: Two arrows, two steps. It listens exactly.
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Now send the duck two steps forward.
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Turn right, then forward. Where does it end up?
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: The shorter one. Fewer steps, same place!
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Which command list reaches the pond fastest? Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: A computer only ever does what it is told.
s05.coding.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: You told the duck exactly what to do.
s05.coding.lesson.01.title: First Commands
s05.coding.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Steps put in the right order make a…
s05.coding.lesson.02.recap.1.prompt: To make toast, which comes first?
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: To make toast: first bread, then toaster, then eat. Drag them in order.
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.2.feedback: Socks first. Shoes will not fit otherwise!
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Now sequence getting dressed: socks, then shoes.
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: It goes wrong. Order is part of the instruction.
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: What if we put the shoes on first? Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: First, next, last. That is a program!
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Sequence your own bedtime in three steps.
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: You have been writing them all your life.
s05.coding.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: A sequence is just a list that must stay in order.
s05.coding.lesson.02.title: Make a Sequence
s05.coding.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: To clap 3 times, what do we use?
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: To clap 3 times, we 'loop' clap x3. Tap to run it.
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Loops repeat steps so we don't write them all.
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Five jumps from one short instruction!
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Now loop 'jump' five times. Tap to run it.
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Four! The number tells you how many times.
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: A loop says clap x4. How many claps?
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: The loop. That is exactly why loops exist.
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Which is shorter to write: a loop, or ten lines? Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Lazy in the best possible way.
s05.coding.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: A loop does the same thing again, without you retyping it.
s05.coding.lesson.03.title: Loops: Do It Again
s05.coding.lesson.04.parentNote: A 'bug' is just a mistake we can find and fix — praise the effort.
s05.coding.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: A mistake in code is called a…
s05.coding.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Fixing a mistake in code is called…
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: The robot should walk to the apple, but one arrow is wrong. Tap the wrong arrow.
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Fix it so the robot reaches the apple.
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.1.prompt: Fixing a mistake in code is…
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Found it. Bugs hide in the middle!
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Here is a longer program. Tap the step that looks wrong.
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: Run it again and watch. Always test twice.
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: How can you check your fix worked? Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: The robot reaches the apple every time now.
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Run it once more, all the way through. Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: That is true for every programmer alive.
s05.coding.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Finding the bug took longer than fixing it.
s05.coding.lesson.04.title: Fix the Bug
s05.coding.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Which command moved the bug two squares higher?
s05.coding.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: Which command moved it toward the leaf?
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Tap up, up to move the bug up two squares.
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Now tap right to reach the leaf.
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Now go down, down, left. Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Fewer moves is usually better code.
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Two paths reach the leaf. Which uses fewer moves? Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Back where you started. A closed shape!
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Tap a square path: right, down, left, up. Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: That is what drawing with code means.
s05.coding.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Arrows made a picture, not just a path.
s05.coding.lesson.05.title: Draw with Code
s05.coding.lesson.06.recap.0.prompt: Drum, bell, drum, bell is a…
s05.coding.lesson.06.recap.1.prompt: How do we play the pattern again?
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Drum, bell, drum, bell. Tap to play the pattern.
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: Add it to a loop to play it again!
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.1.prompt: How do we play it again?
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Add a shaker: drum, bell, shaker. Play it. Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Loop that pattern three times. How many sounds in all?
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: One small change, a whole new song.
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Change one sound and play the loop again. Tap your answer.
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Sequence plus loop. Two ideas, endless songs.
s05.coding.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: You wrote music the way a computer reads it.
s05.coding.lesson.06.title: Music Patterns
s05.coding.quiz.01.questions.0.correctFe: One more forward. You traced the path.
s05.coding.quiz.01.questions.0.prompt: Forward, Forward, ... to reach the star, what is next?
s05.coding.quiz.01.questions.0.retryFeed: Trace the path to the star. Try again!
s05.coding.quiz.01.title: What Comes Next?
s05.coding.quiz.02.questions.0.correctFe: The up arrow moves it up.
s05.coding.quiz.02.questions.0.prompt: Which arrow moves the robot up?
s05.coding.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeed: Which way is up? Try again!
s05.coding.quiz.02.title: Which Arrow?
s05.coding.quiz.03.questions.0.prompt: Wake up, ___, eat breakfast. What's the missing step?
s05.coding.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFeed: What do we do after waking? Try again!
s05.coding.quiz.03.title: Missing Step
s05.coding.quiz.04.parentNote: Clap a loop together before answering.
s05.coding.quiz.04.questions.0.correctFe: Repeat! That is the whole point.
s05.coding.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeed: A loop keeps things going. Try again!
s05.coding.quiz.04.questions.1.correctFe: Three! The number says how many times.
s05.coding.quiz.04.questions.1.prompt: clap x3 means how many claps?
s05.coding.quiz.04.questions.1.retryFeed: The x3 means three. Try again!
s05.coding.quiz.04.title: What Does a Loop Do?
s05.coding.story.01.pages.0.narration: Beep the robot wants to water the plant. Tap to give it steps.
s05.coding.story.01.pages.1.narration: Forward, forward, then pour! Beep follows the steps.
s05.coding.story.01.pages.2.narration: The plant gets water. Good coding, Beep!
s05.coding.story.01.title: Robot Helper
s05.coding.story.02.pages.0.narration: Ama told the robot: put the cup on the table.
s05.coding.story.02.pages.1.narration: It put the cup on the table — upside down.
s05.coding.story.02.pages.2.narration: So Ama said it again, with every step. This time it worked.
s05.coding.story.02.parentNote: Give each other a silly instruction and follow it exactly.
s05.coding.story.02.title: The Robot That Did Exactly That
s05.math.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: 2 apples and 1 more. How many altogether?
s05.math.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: Here are 2 apples. Drag 1 more into the basket.
s05.math.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Count them all. How many now?
s05.math.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Now start with 3 and add 2 more.
s05.math.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Count them all. How many now?
s05.math.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: Both are 3! Order does not change a sum.
s05.math.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: 2 + 1 and 1 + 2. Do they give the same answer?
s05.math.lesson.01.steps.5.feedback: Counters, fingers, or your head — same maths.
s05.math.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: You added four different ways today.
s05.math.lesson.01.title: Add Within 5 with Counters
s05.math.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: 5 apples, take away 1. How many are left?
s05.math.lesson.02.recap.1.prompt: 4 apples, then 2 are eaten. How many remain?
s05.math.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: 5 apples. Eat 1. Tap to take it away.
s05.math.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: Zero! Nothing left is a number too.
s05.math.lesson.02.steps.3.narration: You have 4 and eat them all. How many left?
s05.math.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Does taking away make the number bigger or smaller? Tap your answer.
s05.math.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Adding grows a group; taking away shrinks it.
s05.math.lesson.02.title: Subtract Within 5
s05.math.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Counting on from 11, which comes next?
s05.math.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Tap each star to count past ten: ...11, 12...
s05.math.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: You can start anywhere on the number line!
s05.math.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Count from 10 to 20 without starting at 1.
s05.math.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Faster, and you still land on 20!
s05.math.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: You held the whole line in your head.
s05.math.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Twenty is a long way past ten fingers.
s05.math.lesson.03.title: Count to 20
s05.math.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: 5 and 0 make 5 too. Drag the empty box across.
s05.math.lesson.04.steps.3.feedback: 3! You worked backwards to find it.
s05.math.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: I have 2. How many more to make 5?
s05.math.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: How many different pairs make 5? Tap your answer.
s05.math.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Knowing them by heart makes maths quick later.
s05.math.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Five can be split up lots of ways.
s05.math.lesson.04.title: Number Bonds to 5
s05.math.lesson.05.recap.0.prompt: Two groups with the same number are…
s05.math.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: The group with the bigger number has…
s05.math.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Which has more? Tap the bigger group.
s05.math.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: These two are the same. They are equal.
s05.math.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Which group has fewer? Tap the smaller one.
s05.math.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Add one to the small side, or take one off the big.
s05.math.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: How could you make the two groups equal? Tap your answer.
s05.math.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: Counting both is how you know for sure.
s05.math.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Now compare these two. More, less, or equal? Tap your answer.
s05.math.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: More, less and equal are how numbers get compared.
s05.math.lesson.05.title: More, Less, Equal
s05.math.lesson.06.parentNote: Measure household objects with blocks together.
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.0.feedback: Four cubes long! You measured end to end.
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Lay the cubes along the pencil. How long is it?
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: The crayon is shorter. Three cubes.
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Six cubes! Line them up end to end.
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Measure the book. How many cubes long?
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: The answer comes out wrong. No gaps!
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: What happens if you leave a gap between cubes? Tap your answer.
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: The pencil — four cubes against three.
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: Which is longer: the pencil or the crayon? Tap your answer.
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Careful lining up is the whole skill.
s05.math.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: Measuring is counting, laid end to end.
s05.math.lesson.06.title: Measure with Cubes
s05.math.quiz.01.title: Add It Up
s05.math.quiz.02.questions.0.retryFeedba: Start at 5, count back 2. Try again!
s05.math.quiz.02.title: Take Away
s05.math.quiz.03.questions.0.retryFeedba: Which comes later when counting? Try again!
s05.math.quiz.03.title: Bigger Number
s05.math.quiz.04.parentNote: Act it out with real objects first.
s05.math.quiz.04.questions.0.prompt: You have 3 and get 2 more. What do you do?
s05.math.quiz.04.questions.0.retryFeedba: Getting more means adding. Try again!
s05.math.quiz.04.questions.1.prompt: You have 5 and eat 2. What do you do?
s05.math.quiz.04.title: Add or Take Away?
s05.math.story.01.pages.0.narration: Five friends in a bed. 'Roll over!'
s05.math.story.01.pages.1.narration: One rolls out. Now there are four.
s05.math.story.01.pages.2.narration: One by one, down to one. 'Goodnight!' Five take away four is one.
s05.math.story.01.title: Five in the Bed
s05.math.story.02.pages.0.narration: Ten mangoes, and two friends to share them.
s05.math.story.02.pages.1.narration: One for you, one for me. Again, and again.
s05.math.story.02.pages.2.narration: Five each, and nothing left over. Exactly fair.
s05.math.story.02.parentNote: Share ten real objects between you afterwards.
s05.math.story.02.title: Sharing Ten Mangoes
s05.reading.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Blend the sounds /c/ /a/ /t/. What word do they make?
s05.reading.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Sliding sounds together to read a word is called…
s05.reading.lesson.01.steps.0.feedback: Each letter lights up and says its sound.
s05.reading.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: 'cat!' A cat appears and meows. Great blending!
s05.reading.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Now try h-a-t. Tap each sound.
s05.reading.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: What word do those three sounds make? Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: 'cat!' One sound changed the whole word.
s05.reading.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Change the /h/ to /c/. What word now? Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: You read two words by blending, not guessing.
s05.reading.lesson.01.title: Blend the Sounds: c-a-t
s05.reading.lesson.02.parentNote: Point out 'the', 'I', and 'a' in a favorite book.
s05.reading.lesson.02.recap.0.prompt: Which word did you tap first?
s05.reading.lesson.02.recap.1.prompt: Which word means yourself: I or the?
s05.reading.lesson.02.steps.0.feedback: 'the'. A word we see a lot!
s05.reading.lesson.02.steps.3.feedback: There it is. Sight words show up everywhere.
s05.reading.lesson.02.steps.4.feedback: Right. You know the other three by sight now.
s05.reading.lesson.02.steps.4.narration: Which of these is NOT a sight word you know? Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.02.steps.5.feedback: Knowing these three makes sentences much faster.
s05.reading.lesson.02.steps.5.narration: Some words you sound out; some you just know.
s05.reading.lesson.02.title: Sight Words: I, the, a
s05.reading.lesson.03.recap.0.prompt: When you trace the letter a, where do you start?
s05.reading.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Which letter did you write after a?
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Trace the letter a. Start at the top.
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.1.feedback: You wrote a b! Great writing.
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: A single smooth curve. That is a c!
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Now trace the letter c. One curve, no lifting.
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Trace a, then c. They start the same way.
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.4.feedback: Your letter, in your own hand.
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Write the first letter of your own name.
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.5.feedback: Writing is drawing that everyone can read.
s05.reading.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Letters are made of curves and lines you can already draw.
s05.reading.lesson.03.title: Write Your Letters
s05.reading.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: Blend d-o-g. What word is it?
s05.reading.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Blend m-a-p. What word is it?
s05.reading.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Sound it out: d-o-g. Tap to blend.
s05.reading.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Sound it out: s-u-n. Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Now b-u-s. Take your time. Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.04.steps.4.feedback: 'dog'. The middle sound matters as much as the first.
s05.reading.lesson.04.steps.4.narration: Which word has the /o/ sound in the middle? Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.04.steps.5.feedback: Slow and right beats fast and wrong.
s05.reading.lesson.04.steps.5.narration: Four words blended today, none of them guessed.
s05.reading.lesson.04.title: Blend Words
s05.reading.lesson.05.recap.1.prompt: Which ending sound do pig, big and dig share?
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: p + ig = pig. Tap to read.
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: b + ig = big. d + ig = dig.
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: f + ig = ? Sound it out. Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.3.feedback: Right — it ends with a different sound.
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.3.narration: Which of these is NOT in the -ig family? Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.4.feedback: If it rhymes, the family accepts it!
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.4.narration: Make up your own -ig word, even a silly one. Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.5.feedback: That is why word families are worth knowing.
s05.reading.lesson.05.steps.5.narration: Learn one family and you can read all of it.
s05.reading.lesson.05.title: Word Family: -ig
s05.reading.lesson.06.parentNote: Let your child point to each word as they read.
s05.reading.lesson.06.recap.0.prompt: How many words are in 'I see a cat'?
s05.reading.lesson.06.recap.1.prompt: In 'The cat is big', which word tells the size?
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.0.feedback: 'I... see... a... cat.' You read a sentence!
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: Read with me: 'I see a cat.' Tap each word.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Read this one: 'I see the sun.'
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.3.feedback: 'see'. Every sentence has a doing word.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.3.narration: Which word tells you what you did? Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.4.feedback: A full stop. It tells you where to breathe.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.4.narration: What is at the end of every sentence? Tap your answer.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.5.feedback: Letters, then words, and now sentences. That is the ladder.
s05.reading.lesson.06.steps.5.narration: You read three whole sentences today.
s05.reading.lesson.06.title: Read a Sentence
s05.reading.quiz.01.questions.0.correctF: You blended it. h-a-t spells hat. 🎩
